requestId.description: Ephemeral public correlation only, never a local session ID, cache key or credential.

contextText.description: Selected plain text. Tab, LF and CR are allowed; other terminal controls, format controls, default-ignorables and lone surrogates are not.

meaningfulText.description: Contains at least one Unicode letter, number, punctuation mark or symbol. This rejects blank/control/combining-mark-only context, not semantically unhelpful prose.

statusText.description: One advisory line, 1–140 Unicode codepoints, with visible content. No terminal, bidi/format, default-ignorable, surrogate or Unicode line/paragraph controls.

sessionTitle.description: A short session title in plain text: one line of 1–60 Unicode codepoints and at most 240 UTF-8 bytes, with visible content, no whitespace at either end and no trailing period. The same controls as statusText are rejected.
